verdict.rationale: Marqeta ships an official MCP server that lets AI agents query transaction/balance data, issue virtual cards, and set spend controls (velocity, merchant, cap) via natural language, backed by the same Core API endpoints for cards, users, transactions, and authorization/velocity controls (marqeta-docs-11,12,13,23,38,7,29,30,5,6). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of scoped/least-privilege credentials or per-agent API-key scoping for the MCP server, and independent/hands-on confirmation that write operations (card creation/update) are exposed through the MCP surface itself rather than just the Core API.
